title: US Disaster Costs Are Exploding
source: Sources: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI), U.S. Billion-Dollar Weather and Climate Disasters database (ncei.noaa.gov/access/billions); annual totals for 2005, 2017, 2019, 2020 and 2024 and the 1980s per-year average ($22B) per NOAA Climate.gov year-end reporting.
